title: Awards
description: Manage award dates, allocations and activation. Create awards from a successful application in Pre-Award.

fields.name: reference
fields.label: Award reference
fields.help: Identifier in the signed award agreement

title: Research agreements
description: Record the agreement parties, authorised document, effective dates and accountable owner.

title: Partner allocations
description: Link the funded partner, project role, allocation and agreement record. All allocations retain the award currency.

title: Due diligence reviews
description: Record evidence-based partner or supplier assessments, findings, conditions, risk and review expiry.

fields.name: findings
fields.label: Assessment findings
fields.help: Summarise the evidence reviewed and outstanding issues

title: Award amendments
description: Maintain an auditable amendment request with justification, sponsor requirements and effective date.

fields.name: justification
fields.label: Change requested and justification
fields.help: Explain the change and its effect on delivery, budget and reporting

title: Award deliverables
description: Assign each contractual milestone to an owner, track its due date and retain submission evidence.

title: Award risks and issues
description: Assess exposure, assign an accountable owner and track mitigation and review dates.

title: Award budget positions
description: Review approved budget, cash, expenditure and commitments. Reconciled balances are maintained by Finance; the record does not post to an external ledger.

title: Funder receipts
description: Plan instalments and record cash received with bank or remittance evidence and matching award currency.

title: Grant expenditure
description: Capture a grant cost with its date, cost category, ledger reference and reconciliation state.

title: Outstanding commitments
description: Record expected costs separately from actual expenditure and release a commitment when settled or cancelled.

title: Partner advances
description: Track funds advanced, amounts accounted for and the retirement deadline against the signed partner allocation.

title: Financial reporting
description: Prepare reporting periods, assign preparation and review, attach the authorised report and record submission separately.

title: Finance forecasts
description: Maintain dated financial scenarios with explicit assumptions and expenditure and commitment estimates.

fields.name: assumptions
fields.label: Scenario assumptions
fields.help: State staffing, procurement, exchange-rate and timing assumptions

title: Ledger reconciliations
description: Compare ledger and platform amounts at a specified period end and document the reason for any variance.

title: Financial decisions
description: Record a financial decision against an identifiable transaction. Preparing and deciding officers remain separate.

title: Procurement plans
description: Specify the grant-funded requirement, estimated cost, procurement method, planned date and owner.

title: Purchase requisitions
description: Request a specified purchase against a grant and optional procurement plan before an order is issued.

title: Purchase orders
description: Issue an order against an approved requisition, identify the supplier and track delivery dates.

title: Approved supplier directory
description: Maintain supplier identity and contact information. Due diligence decisions are recorded in the review workspace.

title: Supplier contracts
description: Link a supplier agreement to its purchase order, dates, value and controlled document.

title: Grant assets
description: Maintain the asset register with serial number, grant ownership, custodian, location and acquisition evidence.

title: Laboratory inventory
description: Record grant-funded reagents and equipment with stock units, expiry and maintenance or calibration dates.

title: Equipment maintenance
description: Schedule calibration or maintenance and retain completion dates, provider notes and the service certificate.

title: Ethics and regulatory approvals
description: Link actual ethics or regulatory approvals to the application or award and track authority, evidence and renewal.

title: Conflicts and declarations
description: Record the declarant, relevant grant or award, nature of the disclosure and review status.

title: Information governance assessments
description: Document data categories, lawful basis, access controls, retention, transfers and mitigation for a project.

title: Funder reports
description: Plan the reporting period, assign an owner and retain submitted and accepted evidence.

title: Research outputs
description: Record outputs attributable to an award with a verifiable citation, publication date and source.

title: Impact evidence
description: Separate a claimed impact from verified evidence. Explain the contribution of the grant and retain the supporting source.

title: Award closeout checklist
description: Track each actual technical, financial, partner or asset closeout requirement with an owner and completion evidence.

title: Researcher expertise directory
description: Maintain investigator expertise, methods, track record and availability used for funding matches.

fields.name: selected_track_record
fields.label: Selected grant and publication track record

title: Partner organisations
description: Maintain the legal organisation, contacts, capabilities and collaboration details. Due diligence is governed separately.

title: Funder directory
description: Maintain sponsor identity, funding interests, official website and a verified contact.

title: NHRC institutional profile
description: Maintain the actual strategic themes, capabilities, methods and geography used by the institutional fit engine.

title: Institutional structure
description: Maintain organisational units and reporting relationships used for ownership and role assignment.

title: Approval routing rules
description: Maintain routing definitions with role, sequence and a structured condition. These configuration records do not themselves execute legacy approvals.

title: Acting appointments
description: Record a named appointment and its specific scope, validity and reason. It does not automatically grant permissions.

title: Workflow definitions
description: Maintain lifecycle definitions and inspect their ordered steps. Application transitions remain enforced by the controlled pre-award workflow.

title: Routing steps
description: Specify ordered lifecycle steps, authority and whether an approval is required.

title: Institutional form definitions
description: Maintain versioned field definitions as structured JSON. Operational forms below use their own domain-specific validated fields.

fields.name: schema_json
fields.label: Field definitions
fields.help: Define fields and their validation in a JSON object

title: Research themes
description: Maintain institution-approved research categories for opportunity tagging.

title: Document templates
description: Maintain controlled institutional templates with version and actual source document.

title: Reminder rules
description: Configure reminder timing and responsible function. Deadline automation is controlled independently in Intelligence and Automation.

title: Institutional calendar
description: Maintain actual holidays and working-day exceptions; no dates are invented by the calendar screen.

title: Retention and archive controls
description: Identify the record, retention rule, archive date and legal hold before any disposal review.

title: Access certification
description: Review an actual user role and record the named reviewer, due date and certification decision.

title: Support requests
description: Raise an actionable service request with category, urgency, full description and assigned owner.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Steps, expected result and actual result

title: Institutional notices
description: Publish a timed internal notice to an audience without sending external messages.

title: Integration registry
description: Track the configured integration, direction and accountable owner. Connection status is evidence, not a switch that installs an integration.

title: Operational events
description: Review recorded service and security events and acknowledge actual findings.

title: Business continuity plans
description: Document dependencies, recovery objectives, runbooks, test findings and the next rehearsal.

title: Funding opportunity
description: Record the actual call, official source, sponsor requirements, funding range and submission window.
